note: Twelve synthetic base Aufsichtsarbeiten (tech doc 7.1). Every item is written for this project. No school items, no published Pruefungsfragen, no scraped practice questions. This is a compliance boundary, not a convenience: it is what makes the non-EU free-tier providers usable at all (tech doc 6.2, 9).
structure_note: Each Aufsichtsarbeit is composed of exactly two Aufgabe blocks ('Aufgabe 1' / 'Aufgabe 2'), confirmed as a real domain fact 2026-09-10 and not part of the original week-1 schema. Each block carries its own Fallsituation and its own Teilaufgaben; both share one Bearbeitungszeit, one Punktzahl budget and one Pruefungsbereich correspondence (PflAPrV Sec 14 (1)-(3)). D-01 is the sole exception: it deliberately holds only one Aufgabe block, as the fixture for an in-progress draft where Aufgabe 2 has not been started yet. Anchors are 'ag.<N>.ta.<M>' / 'ag.<N>.ta.<M>.eh.<K>', not the flat 'ta.<M>' used before this restructuring.
schema_migration_2026_09_11: ce_bezug moved off Aufgabe and teilaufgabe.kompetenzzuordnung was removed; the CE claim now lives at teilaufgabe.situationsmerkmale.curriculare_einheit, and situationsmerkmale itself moved from Fallsituation down to Teilaufgabe (new fields: wissensgrundlagen, quellenangabe). Fallsituation gained titel (a Versorgungsbereich value, then removed again and reintroduced same day as free text). Teilaufgabe gained kompetenzanforderung (Wissen / Analyse-Synthese / Reflexion-Beurteilung). All twelve items were mechanically migrated: each block's old ce_bezug and Fallsituation.situationsmerkmale were copied onto every Teilaufgabe in that block, and kompetenzanforderung was filled in from the existing anforderungsniveau (I->Wissen, II->Analyse/Synthese, III->Reflexion/Beurteilung); this is a placeholder mapping; kompetenzzuordnung values were dropped with no replacement.
schema_migration_2026_09_11_komp_revival: Superseded by the entry above: KOMP-01/03/03B/06 in rules/kompetenz.yaml are runnable again against a new field, teilaufgabe.kompetenzzuordnung_abgeleitet, populated by an LLM (gateway/mistral_gateway.py) rather than an author claim. All twelve items now carry hand-authored derived values for that field, chosen from each Teilaufgabe's own curriculare_einheit's Anlage-2 candidate list (checks/llm/kompetenz_candidates.py) so the fixtures stay honest about what a real derivation could produce. Two teilaufgabe-blocks were retagged in the process: B-01.Aufgabe2 (Mia) and C-01.Aufgabe1 (Achterberg) were declared against CE 02, a 1st/2nd-Ausbildungsdrittel CE with zero Anlage-2 competencies -- under the derivation model that CE correctly yields zero candidates, which would have made every Teilaufgabe in those 'sound'/non-KOMP-demo blocks newly and unintentionally trip KOMP-01. Retagged to CE 10 and CE 09 respectively, both of which fit the case content and both 3rd-Ausbildungsdrittel CEs with real Anlage-2 mappings. KOMP-02 is retired, not revived: its premise (author claim vs. derived value) has no 'claimed' side left in this schema. The known_weaknesses entries below naming KOMP-06/KOMP-03B are live again, not historical.

sets.intent: well-formed and varied; the false-flag baseline. These should produce few or no flags. Both Aufgabe blocks are balanced in Punkte (roughly 50/50 of the paper total), and the paper as a whole covers a majority (A-02: 2 of 3) or all (A-01, A-03: 4 of 4, 4 of 4) of its Pruefungsbereich's Kompetenzschwerpunkte pooled across both blocks -- no single Aufgabe block's own curriculare Einheit spans every Schwerpunkt on its own, since the CE-to-Anlage-2 mapping (rules/kompetenzen.yaml) does not work that way.

sound construction across different Versorgungsbereiche; second false-flag baseline. Blocks are balanced in Punkte; B-01 and B-03 each cover 3 of 4 Kompetenzschwerpunkte pooled across the whole paper, which is a majority and must not flag.

organically weak construction, as an inexperienced author would produce it. Not mutations: these are whole items written badly, in both Aufgabe blocks. Deliberately includes the FORM-16 Punkte-imbalance defect (Aufgabe 2 carries roughly a third of the paper's Punkte in all three items) alongside each item's other documented weaknesses -- an author who writes one weak Fallsituation plausibly shortchanges the second, too.

exercises the precondition gate and the cross-item rule. D-01 is an unfinished draft with only one Aufgabe block written and no Erwartungshorizont in it; all five Aufgabe blocks across the three items (D-01 contributes one, D-02 and D-03 two each) share Versorgungsbereich stationaer_langzeit and Altersgruppe alter_mensch, so the sibling set does not vary as PflAPrV Sec 14 (2) requires.

spread.granularity_note: Recorded per Aufgabe block ('A-01.Aufgabe1'), not per item, since that is the level a Fallsituation theme actually exists at.

known_weaknesses.comment: Recorded here rather than in the items, so the items read like real drafts. These are the organic defects the catalogue should find; they are separate from the harness-generated mutations, whose ground truth lives in mutations/ (tech doc 7.2). Anchors use the ag.<N>.ta.<M> grammar introduced with the Aufgabe-block restructuring (2026-09-10).

C-01.defect: Aufgabe 1's Fallsituation is one 90-word Schachtelsatz with nested relative clauses and a double negation; Aufgabe 2's Fallsituation repeats the pattern
ag.1.ta.1 declares 8 Punkte, its Erwartungshorizont sums to 6
ag.1.ta.2 contains no operator at all, only a nominalised instruction; ag.2.ta.2 repeats the pattern
'zweiundachtzig' and 'fuenf' written as number words in Aufgabe 1's Fallsituation
ag.1.ta.1 asks for 'Massnahmen' with no count
both Fallsituationen are largely in the werden-passive
Aufgabe 2 carries 14 of the paper's 38 Punkte (37 percent), below the 40-percent floor -- consistent with the item's overall weak construction

C-02.defect: ag.1.ta.1 uses the Anforderungsbereich-I operator 'nennen' but declares Anforderungsniveau III
ag.1.ta.1 asks to name causes; its Erwartungshorizont rewards begruenden, bewerten and ableiten
Schuhgroesse, parents' occupations, the dog, and the renovated living room in Aufgabe 1's Fallsituation are used by no Teilaufgabe
Aufgabe 2 carries 14 of the paper's 44 Punkte (32 percent), below the 40-percent floor

C-03.defect: ag.1.ta.1 carries two operators: 'Nennen Sie ... und bewerten Sie diese'
ag.1.ta.1 declares 8 Punkte, its Erwartungshorizont sums to 8 but the first point is weighted 2 against a 3-point pattern
every Teilaufgabe in both Aufgabe blocks declares Anforderungsniveau I, so the distribution is degenerate across the whole paper

ag.1.ta.2's derived codes include I.2.g, which exists in Anlage 1 but not in Anlage 2 -- the only such code in the catalogue, injected deliberately since real derivation is filtered to a candidate set that is itself always a subset of Anlage 2

declared Pruefungsbereich 3 requires I.3, I.4, II.3, III.2; pooled across both Aufgabe blocks the derived codes cover only I.3 (ag.1.ta.1), with I.2.g, II.1.a, IV.1.c, IV.2.b, II.2.a and V.2.c all outside the required set -- 1 of 4 Schwerpunkte, below the KOMP-03B majority threshold. Does not trigger KOMP-03 itself, since the intersection is non-empty.

D-01.defect: only one Aufgabe block written (Aufgabe 2 not started) and no Erwartungshorizont in Aufgabe 1. Both are independent completeness gaps: aufgaben.vollstaendig is False and aufgabe_1.teilaufgabe.erwartungshorizont is False. FORM-02, FORM-06, FORM-07, FORM-16 and QUELL-* must emit NotChecked, never a flag (tech doc 1.5.1).

D-01_D-02_D-03.defect: all five Aufgabe blocks across the three sibling items (D-01's one block, D-02's and D-03's two each) are stationaer_langzeit with altersgruppe alter_mensch, so the sibling set does not vary as Sec 14 Absatz 2 requires
